title: Adding Integers

copy.studentInstructions: Add the two integers. Pay attention to both signs and mark the matching sum in the question’s column.
copy.roomIntro: Add integers from −15 to 15. Questions include two positive numbers, two negative numbers, mixed signs, zero, and opposites that cancel. Addends grow in magnitude from M to O.
copy.callerSubtitle: Add the integers. Check the signs. Find your square.
copy.joinIntro: Enter your teacher’s room code to join.
copy.bankIntro: 50 questions, 10 per column, using integer addends from −15 to 15 and sums from −30 to 30. Maximum addend magnitudes progress through 5, 8, 10, 12, and 15 in M, A, T, H, and O. Each column contains both positive and negative sums; nearby and opposite-signed answers reward calculation. Includes zero and cancellation. Signed-in edits save to your private teacher library.

caller.default: Add both integers and check the sign. Find the sum in column {letter}.

student.default: Add the two integers. Check both signs and column {letter}.

presentationSubtitle: Add positive and negative integers. Watch both signs. Find the sum.
